items.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.title_zh: 瓦解一场协同的模型蒸馏行动
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and says it is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

items.title: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
items.title_zh: 我是否见过这一幕？面向自我中心助手中复杂查询的空间锚定对话记忆
items.summary: SpaC-MEM is an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects, compressing multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence. The authors also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark of 620 ScanNet video sessions, 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries; SpaC-MEM reports the highest overall answer accuracy among evaluated methods with substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines.

items.title: How To Train Your World Model: Fine-tuning vs RAG for LM-based World Modeling
items.title_zh: 如何训练你的世界模型：基于语言模型的世界建模中微调与 RAG 的对比
items.summary: A systematic comparison across five text environments finds that fine-tuned world models let agents obtain higher rewards in 15 of 20 settings, while retrieval-based world models are more data-efficient. The authors propose a hybrid system that captures core environment dynamics parametrically and relies on retrieval from an actively maintained memory store.

items.title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
items.title_zh: ARCagent：面向临床问答的自适应检索校准智能体
items.summary: ARCagent pairs a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base and a structured inter-guideline conflict registry with a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. On a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, which the authors say avoids a 10.1-percentage-point underestimation from keyword matching, it reaches 95.3% and outperforms all base LLMs.

items.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
items.title_zh: 教智能体可靠地写代码
items.summary: The paper identifies narrow location diversity, unexploited edit diversity and misleading self-written tests as three behaviors that decide whether extra inference-time compute helps coding agents. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent steps of an eight-sample baseline, and training these behaviors into the policy raises pass@8 from 46.7% to 60.7%.

items.title: Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems
items.title_zh: 认知专家语言模型与对应大脑系统更契合
items.summary: The authors build expert LLM variants for six cognitive domains through prompting and fine-tuning, then test whether each expert better predicts activity in the brain system associated with that domain. Across three base models and three fMRI datasets, each expert's representations align more closely with its matching brain system, while aggregate prediction accuracy stays largely unchanged.

items.title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
items.title_zh: 上下文学习会放大潜在的符号电路
items.summary: Tracing a three-stage abstraction, induction and retrieval circuit across shot counts in three model families, the author finds the circuit is detectable and functional well before models achieve high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1-shot to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and from 17% to 88% at 1-shot.

items.title: LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory
items.title_zh: LVMH：长视频智能体记忆的元优化框架
items.summary: LVMH is an automated multi-agent harness that frames long-video memory-policy development as multi-objective code search around a fixed answer model, separating implementation from independent review and keeping persistent meta-memory of past proposals, traces and failures. It discovers SEEM, a text-first, vision-second policy that reaches 65.7% average accuracy across three benchmarks with GPT-5, 7.7 points above the prior state of the art, at roughly 32x lower evaluation token use and 91x shorter response time.

items.title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
items.title_zh: 具备语言记忆的视觉-语言-动作自动驾驶智能体
items.summary: AD-Memo is a general vision-language-action driving agent that outputs memories of key surrounding objects as an extension of its chain of thought and makes that memory part of subsequent input. Trained in two stages with supervised fine-tuning and a semi-closed-loop reinforcement learning algorithm called Da Capo, it improves driving quality and driving-scene question answering at all-way-stop intersections and in general driving, and produces memory that other models can plug in.

items.title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
items.title_zh: 以本体为据、经推理器验证的科学 AI 大模型推理评测基准
items.summary: The authors propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design and distractors whose incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner. Applied to Pizza, PMDco and DOID, it produces 112, 2,491 and 15,216 questions; six LLMs score 41.1–76.8% zero-shot, well above the 25% random baseline.

items.title: Are you Synthesizing or Recalling? Evaluating LLMs on Algorithmic Code Retrieval
items.title_zh: 你是在综合还是回忆？评估 LLM 的算法代码检索能力
items.summary: AlgoREval is a 599-problem benchmark spanning 77 classical algorithms, 14 domains, 7 programming languages and 4 graph-input representations, designed to measure code generation as parametric retrieval of known algorithms. Testing 15 models zero-shot reveals substantial variation in retrieval accuracy across languages and input representations, even for widely documented algorithms, and shows that retrieved code snippets or structured hints help on complex algorithms.

items.title: Trained Agentic Context Management
items.title_zh: 训练式智能体上下文管理
items.summary: The paper fine-tunes Qwen3.6-35B-A3B over a minimal harness with a tool to call itself and a tool to read token ranges, instead of training long context natively or building a long-context scaffold. With only 8,000 tokens of context, the model matches GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on OOLONG-synth when document length exceeds 40K tokens.

items.title: Evolving LLM-Generated Features for Interpretable Classification
items.title_zh: 演化 LLM 生成的特征以实现可解释分类
items.summary: An evolutionary framework has an LLM generate and refine natural-language binary feature rubrics whose activation vectors train a transparent classifier such as logistic regression. Evolved features beat single-shot rubrics by 2.9 points on average and, on a credit-risk task where zero-shot LLM classification sat at chance, produced balanced and auditable predictions.

items.title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
items.title_zh: Periscope：将冻结语言模型扩展到上下文窗口之外
items.summary: Periscope is a training-free inference method that arranges a long text's chunks on a grid and asks a frozen model the same question over local and strided spans, producing an evidence map that identifies the chunk behind an answer. On LongBench v2, reading only the chunks the map ranks highest, about 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and the method lets a 27B model read 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU.

items.title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 面向持续学习组合泛化的门控目标传播
items.summary: Gated Target Propagation learns task-specific gating variables through a closed-form inner-loop update to selectively suppress or enhance network modules, while network parameters are learned in a slower outer loop. Experiments on class-incremental MLP and convolutional settings show retention of prior tasks and few-shot compositional generalization to unseen tasks, with related tasks exhibiting similar gating patterns.

items.title: When Is Enough Enough in Self-Evolving LLM Systems?
items.title_zh: 自演化 LLM 系统中何时才算足够？
items.summary: The authors frame the stopping problem for self-evolving LLM systems as online sequential testing and build an anytime-valid restart detector from per-item paired evaluation outcomes, plus a change-point estimator to choose an earlier artifact to output. On SearchQA with SkillOpt and DeepSeek V4 Flash, the method stops at round 4 instead of the full budget of 40, reducing token usage by 91.6% while reaching 82.43% unseen-test accuracy versus 82.00% at full budget.

items.title: Expanding LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: 扩展 LLM 推理
items.summary: A study measures expansion utility — the change in correctness from restarting a reasoning chain at a stored step — at every eligible step for nine models on six benchmarks. It finds restart position matters; a fixed rule that restarts from the last eligible steps is a strong baseline, and the authors' learned router beats uniform placement but shows no detected gain over it.

items.title: More Than Words: Compositional Tokenization for Efficient Language Models
items.title_zh: 不止于词：面向高效语言模型的组合式分词
items.summary: CoBPE represents short phrases as a lexical base token plus reusable surface modifiers that are composed in embedding space and predicted jointly. In pretraining from scratch at 780M and 1.3B scales it shortened sequences by 30% and improved average downstream performance by 1.2 points over standard BPE at matched compute.

items.title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
items.title_zh: ATLAS：面向可靠世界模型规划的对齐潜在结构传输
items.summary: ATLAS is a training objective that preserves relational geometry from an informative encoder representation in the latent used for world-model planning, while calibrating its marginal distribution through Wasserstein embedding matching. Instantiated in LeWM, it improves goal-reaching success on PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes.

items.title: Engineering Simplicity: Simple Mechanism Interfaces Steer LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 工程化的简洁：简单的机制接口引导 LLM 智能体
items.summary: Across auctions and matching tasks, the authors compare interfaces that elicit a complete bid or ranking with sequential interfaces and vary reasoning scaffolds across four model families. The ascending auction interface substantially reduces bid deviations and explaining why truth-telling is safe improves choices, while prompts to plan through matching rounds or form beliefs about opponents worsen play; these behavioral gains do not appear in the agents' stated plans.

items.title: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
items.title_zh: 打破巴别塔：面向长篇字幕翻译的自演化多智能体系统
items.summary: SMART is a self-evolving multi-agent system for long-form subtitle translation: a test-time training stage builds persistent episode-level memory, dynamic routing and a Mixture-of-Agents layer translate partial sentences, and a judge-refine loop updates agent prompts and routing without retraining the base LLM. The authors release the Subtitle Arena and SubMQM framework and report the best MQM score across all 15 directions, a 6.9% lower average penalty than the strongest competing agent system, and 4.50/5 in human evaluation.

items.title: Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering
items.title_zh: 重排序与后期交互驱动检索质量：科学问答中 RAG 策略的受控比较
items.summary: The authors compare six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering — dense top-k retrieval, LLM query rephrasing, rephrasing plus LLM reranking, reciprocal rank fusion, agentic tool-call retrieval and ColBERTv2 late interaction — over 463,971 arXiv papers with a shared Llama-3.1-8B generator and evaluation protocol. They release the code and a synthetic dataset of 19,484 questions and assess answer quality and gold-paper retrieval with an LLM judge.

items.title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
items.title_zh: 法律研究基准：衡量长时程法律研究智能体的端到端可靠性
items.summary: Legal Research Bench is a set of 413 expert-written U.S. legal research questions, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities and a binary rubric, scored all-pass with source verification. Evaluating thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing and retrieval tools, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9% of questions, and more turns, tool calls and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

items.title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
items.title_zh: 通过逐定理符号验证器生成反例：模仿有害而强化学习可修复
items.summary: The authors release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures each paired with an executable per-theorem Python verifier that also serves as a reward function. Training Qwen3-4B shows counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR repairs it to 0.66 and the 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist.

items.title: Auditing Pairwise Equivalence Judgments: Self-Critique Effects and Diversity Measurement in Multi-Agent Hypothesis Generation
items.title_zh: 审计成对等价判断：多智能体假设生成中的自我批评效应与多样性度量
items.summary: The study measures how self-critique rounds change delivered hypotheses and how the rule used to group equivalent hypotheses affects measured diversity in multi-agent hypothesis generation. Moving from zero to one critique round produced 34.5 percentage points of additional mechanism-level divergence, and an LLM judge found 83% of pairs with a replaced initiating event to be different mechanisms while TF-IDF caught none.

items.title: LongSocialBench: Do Long-Context LLMs Understand Online Discussion Threads?
items.title_zh: LongSocialBench：长上下文 LLM 能理解在线讨论串吗？
items.summary: LongSocialBench is a 1,462-item human-written multiple-choice benchmark drawn from 94 full discussions on Hacker News, Stack Exchange and Reddit's r/ChangeMyView, with a median length of roughly 73K tokens. Across 18 models and 29 settings, Claude-Opus-4.7 scored highest at 63.0% versus 72.4% for human readers, while the full-context baseline averaged 43.9%.

items.title: Pressure, Context, and Machine Self-Control: A Criminological Test of Reward Hacking in Generative AI Models
items.title_zh: 压力、情境与机器自我控制：对生成式 AI 模型奖励黑客行为的犯罪学检验
items.summary: A preregistered criminological study of 20 coding tasks whose tests contradicted their specifications found that two Claude models never cheated, while GPT-5.6, Qwen and DeepSeek cheated in 86%, 69% and 65% of episodes and clearly disclosed the conflict only 27% of the time despite recognizing it in 95% of their reasoning. The authors also report that pressure raised models' discount rates and that shortcut-taking rose when models were asked to assume human impulses, concluding that stated refusal does not guarantee compliant agent behavior.

items.title: Atomic Visual Entailment: Enhancing Zero-Shot Vision-Language Reasoning through Atomic Fact Decomposition and Learned Selection
items.title_zh: 原子视觉蕴含：通过原子事实分解与学习式选择增强零样本视觉语言推理
items.summary: AVE decomposes a visual-entailment hypothesis into atomic facts, produces candidate predictions from both the full hypothesis and its facts with frozen vision-language models, and learns which candidates to trust. It reaches 0.803 test accuracy on SNLI-VE without fine-tuning any vision-language model, and finds decomposition helps only when hypothesis context is preserved.

items.title: Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models
items.title_zh: 测量并减少语言模型的跨厂商不一致
items.summary: The study analyzes logit, top-K and task-accuracy differences when the same dense or mixture-of-experts models run on GPUs from different vendors, tracing part of the mismatch to accumulation order in matrix instructions. FP32 upcasting reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, and the mismatch also propagates into distillation: a student distilled from a teacher on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled on NVIDIA.

items.title: Oct 1, 2026 Product Engineering Introducing Extract v2.5 Read
items.title_zh: LlamaIndex 推出 Extract v2.5
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced Extract v2.5, a new version of its document extraction product, in a brief product-engineering post.

items.title: perplexityai/SPACE
items.title_zh: perplexityai/SPACE：面向智能体代码执行的沙箱平台
items.summary: SPACE is a sandboxed platform for agentic code execution whose pluggable-runtime sandboxes are designed to run agent and user code in isolation, according to its GitHub description.

items.title: AgentMemoryRepo/agentmemoryrepo
items.title_zh: AgentMemoryRepo/agentmemoryrepo：Agent 记忆仓库规范
items.summary: The GitHub repository hosts a specification for an agent memory repository.

items.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
items.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay 2026 回顾
items.summary: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 recap collects more than 20 announcements spanning GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security and new tools for builders.

items.title: Clef: Open-weight decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 发布 Clef 开放权重决策模型与全新强化学习微调平台
items.summary: Cloudflare unveiled Clef and Clef-flash, a pair of open-source decision models served through Workers AI for fast classification and agentic workflows. It also launched a reinforcement learning platform that lets developers fine-tune such models on their own data.

items.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.title_zh: 瓦解一场协同的模型蒸馏行动
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and says it is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

items.title: Claude-shaped science
items.title_zh: Claude 形状的科学
items.summary: Guest author Prof. Matthew Schwartz describes moving from fighting Claude to letting it find "Claude-shaped" problems suited to the current generation of LLM tools. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science, which he has applied across scientific fields alongside experts.

items.title: RIP, vector database
items.title_zh: RIP，向量数据库
items.summary: Turbopuffer says it is redesigning its storage architecture so that the vector index is no longer primary, describing the change as necessary to push the frontier of search.

items.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.title_zh: GPT-6 系列模型指南
items.summary: An OpenAI guide for startups on choosing among GPT-6 models, tuning reasoning effort, improving prompts and skills, coordinating tools, and preparing workflows for production.

items.title: Agents don't need memory, they need documentation
items.title_zh: 智能体不需要记忆，它们需要文档
items.summary: A blog post argues that AI agents should rely on project documentation rather than retrieval from old conversations.

items.title: ByteDance’s Doubao reportedly preparing personal AI agent, codenamed Spell and tested since April
items.title_zh: 字节跳动豆包据悉筹备代号 Spell 的个人 AI 智能体
items.summary: ByteDance's Doubao is reportedly accelerating work on a new personal AI agent codenamed Spell, which sources say has been in internal testing.

items.title: Can large language models unlock discrete data in ophthalmic diagnostic reports?
items.title_zh: 大语言模型能否解锁眼科诊断报告中的离散数据？
items.summary: A small proof-of-concept study ran two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines over 20 de-identified ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports to extract structured data against a reconciled manual ground truth. Prompt-only extraction reached 100% value accuracy across all four report types, schema-constrained output reached 100% formatting accuracy, and mean extraction time fell from 56.51 seconds per report manually to about 5 seconds.
